name: the garrison's practice yard
notes: Training level B3 (D-59): an outdoor practice yard. Fields as in data/maps/village.json.

art.ground: a packed-earth practice yard inside a timber palisade, trampled bare in a wide ring in the middle, scattered straw and a few pebbles

pieces.Barracks: a long, low timber barracks with a shingle roof and a plank door facing down
pieces.Armoury: a small square stone armoury with a heavy wooden door and a barred window
pieces.WeaponRack: a wooden weapon rack holding practice swords, staves and round wicker shields
pieces.Dummy1: a straw practice dummy on a wooden post, shaped like a man, with a sack for a head
pieces.Dummy2: a battered straw practice dummy on a post, its sack head half torn
pieces.Trough: a long wooden water trough on legs
